recent.title: Ibyanditswe biheruka
recent.description: Ibintu bitanu biheruka kwandikwa mu gihe cyatoranyijwe.
recent.caption: Ibyanditswe biheruka mu gihe cyatoranyijwe, hamwe n'itariki, icyo amafaranga yakoreshejwe n'ingano yayo.
recent.emptyTitle: Nta kintu cyanditswe muri iki gihe
recent.emptyBody: Hitamo igihe kirekire, cyangwa wandike icya mbere mu gitabo cy'amafaranga.

ledger.title: Igitabo cy'amafaranga
ledger.description: Amafaranga yose koperative yanditse, aheruka abanza.
ledger.caption: Ibyanditswe mu bitabo bya koperative, hamwe n'inomero, itariki, icyiciro, ingano y'amafaranga n'uburyo bwanyuzemo.
ledger.exportFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona idosiye. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
ledger.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona igitabo cy'amafaranga. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
ledger.totalsCover: Iyi mibare itatu ireba impapuro zose z'ibyatoranyijwe.
ledger.emptyBody: Andika amafaranga ya mbere yinjiye cyangwa yasohotse, hanyuma agaragara hano n'inomero yayo.
ledger.emptyFilteredBody: Agura igihe cyangwa ingano y'amafaranga, cyangwa ukureho ibyatoranyijwe urebe igitabo cyose.

entry.editFixed: Ingano y'amafaranga, icyerekezo n'itariki y'ikintu cyanditswe ntibihinduka. Umubare utari wo uhagarikwa, hanyuma handikwe igikosora, kandi byombi bigume mu bitabo.

void.title: Uremeza guhagarika iki cyanditswe?
void.consequence: Icyanditswe kiguma mu bitabo, kandi iruhande rwacyo handikwe igikosora kingana na cyo ku rundi ruhande, ku buryo amafaranga asigaye asubira uko yari. Nta kintu gisibwa.
void.reasonHint: Umurongo umwe, urugero: cyanditswe kabiri mu makosa.

entryDialog.descriptionIn: Amafaranga koperative yakiriye. Yiyongera ku mafaranga asigaye ako kanya nyuma y'iyandikwa.
entryDialog.descriptionOut: Amafaranga koperative yishyuye. Akurwa ku mafaranga asigaye ako kanya nyuma y'iyandikwa.
entryDialog.noCategoriesIn: Nta cyiciro cy'amafaranga yinjira kiracyashyizweho, bityo amafaranga yinjiye ntashobora kwandikwa. Banza wongere icyiciro ku rupapuro rw'ibyiciro.
entryDialog.noCategoriesOut: Nta cyiciro cy'amafaranga asohoka kiracyashyizweho, bityo amafaranga yasohotse ntashobora kwandikwa. Banza wongere icyiciro ku rupapuro rw'ibyiciro.

entryFields.amountHint: Amafaranga yuzuye, urugero 5000. Ibice by'ijana ntarenga bibiri.
entryFields.occurredAtHint: Uyu munsi, keretse amafaranga yimutse ku yindi tariki.
entryFields.descriptionHint: Umurongo umwe ibiro bizumva n'umwaka utaha, urugero: inyemezabwishyu 04521, urugendo rwa Kigali.
entryFields.memberHint: Usige ubusa keretse amafaranga yishyuwe cyangwa yakiriwe ku munyamuryango umwe. Kumwandika bibishyira ku rupapuro rwe.
entryFields.memberPlaceholder: Shakisha ku izina, inomero y'umunyamuryango cyangwa telefone

entryErrors.amount: Andika ingano irenze zeru, ukoresheje imibare gusa, ibice by'ijana ntarenga bibiri.

categories.title: Ibyiciro
categories.description: Ibyo amafaranga ya koperative abarizwamo. Icyiciro ntikisibwa, gihagarikwa gusa.
categories.loadFailed: Ntitwashoboye kubona ibyiciro. Reba uko interineti ihagaze hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
categories.showInactiveHint: Icyiciro cyahagaritswe ntikibona ibyanditswe bishya, ariko kigumana ibyari bisanzwe bibarizwa muri cyo.
categories.captionIn: Ibyiciro by'amafaranga yinjira, hamwe n'izina mu Kinyarwanda, kode, umubare w'ibyanditswe bibikoresha n'igiteranyo cyabyo.
categories.captionOut: Ibyiciro by'amafaranga asohoka, hamwe n'izina mu Kinyarwanda, kode, umubare w'ibyanditswe bibikoresha n'igiteranyo cyabyo.
categories.emptyBody: Amafaranga ntashobora kwandikwa igihe nta cyiciro abarizwamo.
categories.deactivateInUse: Hari ibyanditswe {{entries}} bisanzwe bibarizwa muri cyo. Bikomeza kugira icyo cyiciro kandi nta na kimwe gihinduka. Gusa ntikizongera kugaragara mu gihe handikwa amafaranga mashya.
categories.deactivateUnused: Nta kintu kiracyabarizwa muri cyo. Ntikizongera kugaragara mu gihe handikwa amafaranga mashya, kandi gishobora kongera gusubizwaho igihe icyo ari cyo.
categories.restoreConsequence: Kizongera kugaragara mu gihe handikwa amafaranga mashya.

categoryDialog.kindFixedIn: Iki ni icyiciro cy'amafaranga yinjira, kandi kizaguma ari cyo. Ubwoko bw'icyiciro ntibuhinduka: kubuhindura byahindura uruhande rw'amafaranga asigaye ibyanditswe bimaze kubarizwa muri cyo bibarizwa.
categoryDialog.kindFixedOut: Iki ni icyiciro cy'amafaranga asohoka, kandi kizaguma ari cyo. Ubwoko bw'icyiciro ntibuhinduka: kubuhindura byahindura uruhande rw'amafaranga asigaye ibyanditswe bimaze kubarizwa muri cyo bibarizwa.
categoryDialog.systemOrigin: Iki cyiciro cyaje na sisitemu. Izina ryacyo rishobora guhindurwa kandi gishobora guhagarikwa, kandi nka buri cyiciro ntikisibwa.

categoryFields.name: Izina
categoryFields.nameRwHint: Rigaragarira abasoma sisitemu mu Kinyarwanda. Rireke ubusa kugira ngo hakoreshwe izina riri haruguru.
categoryFields.codeHint: Ku koperative isanzwe iha ibyiciro byayo inomero ku rupapuro.

categoryErrors.name: Izina rirasabwa.
categoryErrors.nameRw: Iryo zina mu Kinyarwanda rirerure cyane.

apiErrors.voidFromSource: Iki cyanditswe kivuye mu nyandiko y'umunyamuryango. Gihagarike ku misanzu cyangwa ku migabane y'uwo munyamuryango, ku buryo ibitabo n'amateka y'umunyamuryango bihuza.
apiErrors.voidedNotEditable: Icyanditswe cyahagaritswe ntigihinduka. Kiguma uko kiri, iruhande rw'igikosora cyacyo.
apiErrors.categoryNameTaken: Hari icyiciro gisanzwe gifite iryo zina ku ruhande rumwe rw'ibitabo.
